package.name: fsai_vehicle_interface
package.description:
ROS 2 hardware abstraction layer for the ADS-DV vehicle over CAN bus. Wraps the FS-AI API C library, publishes VCU sensor data as ROS 2 topics, and forwards drive commands from the autonomous stack to the vehicle.
This package vendors the FS-AI_API C source files internally and is self-contained — it does not depend on the FS-AI_API repository being present on the build machine.
